headline: Khaitan & Co, JSA act on IIFL Finance updating its $1 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme
sum: IIFL Finance Limited has updated its existing $1 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme (GMTN Programme) on the IFSC Gift City stock exchanges (India INX and NSE IX).
detail: IIFL Finance Limited has updated its existing $1 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme (GMTN Programme) on the IFSC Gift City stock exchanges (India INX and NSE IX). Khaitan & Co advised IIFL Finance on this transaction. The transaction team consisted of Manisha Shroff (Partner), Rajshekhar Upadhyaya (Principal Associate), Nikunj Mehta (Senior Associate), Associates Charul Lunia, Nandini Arya and Shivansh Kumar Jain. Vinita Krishnan (Executive Director), Ashish Mehta (Partner), Sneh Shah (Partner), Ujjval Gangwal (Principal Associate) and Pal Jain (Associate) provided advice on Tax law aspects.
